snippet.title: Storebound |  Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Storebound Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417410/Storebound/ 

Storebound is 1-3 co-op survival horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an endless store. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

Follow on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@storebound 
Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/storebound_game/ 
Join on Discord: https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq
